name: boss-5
about: Boss Rush: Group Golem (a slab golem built of filing cabinets). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss05-golem-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
bar: the game's one quality bar for a hero model (2026-11-17): 2048 px colour, 1024 px other maps, about 55K triangles
